results.headline: How four models compare on image moderation, by accuracy, speed and cost
results.lede: We ran Cloudflare clef-flash, TypeSafe Jev, Claude Haiku 5.5 and Amazon Rekognition over all 10,146 images in UnsafeBench with the same prompt and scoring, and report accuracy on the held-out test split.

table.headline: Full results by model and by content category
table.lede: Bold marks the best score in each ranked column. Differences of a few hundredths are within the bootstrap intervals, so read close scores as ties.
